title: Slate lists games with no price rows ("No prices yet"); 26 of 67 CBB games, 2 of 4 tennis, 1 NFL
steps: GET /api/slate?sport=cbb and count rows where main == null

Example cbb-cc3ac570d384a1a9 Drexel Dragons @ Maine Black Bears (2026-11-21T22:00Z): snapshots exist only for betonlineag and lowvig (spread/total), no ml; no bettable book, so filterFeed drops everything as no_price
Compare with demo-db.json market_prices: only 1 of the 26 events has any row
expected: Rule: rows with no price never appear in the feed.
actual: The event row still appears on the slate with "No prices yet" (and counts in "N upcoming games"). feed_filter_log id 72: no_price=345 of 1364 rows_in (25%).
evidence: /api/slate?sport=cbb: 26 rows main=null; tennis 2, nfl 1. Snapshot books for the example event: betonlineag, lowvig only; market_prices best_book is only ever draftkings/fanduel/betmgm/betrivers.
suspected_area: packages/db/src/feed.ts buildSlate (lists every scheduled event regardless of priced rows); bettable-book filter in priceMarkets
